fleetops_domain_knowledge.overview: This file contains FleetOps-specific domain knowledge for cold-chain logistics, agent orchestration patterns, and common workflows.

cold_chain_logistics.definition: Cold-chain logistics involves transporting temperature-sensitive cargo (pharmaceuticals, food, chemicals) while maintaining specific temperature ranges.

concept.name: time_to_spoilage
concept.description: Time remaining before cargo spoils if temperature exceeds threshold

concept.name: emergency_reroute
concept.description: Immediate route change to nearest service facility

sequential_chain.description: FleetOps uses a sequential agent chain where each agent's output becomes input for the next agent.

step.output: List of available facilities with capabilities
Ranked routes with travel times and costs

step.input: All previous outputs + telemetry + cargo data
step.action: Analyze all data and make final decision
step.output: Decision with selected route, facility, and recommendations

data_flow_principles.principle: Each agent receives ALL data from previous agents
Agents pass data through without modification
Only the Decision Agent makes recommendations
All agents output pure JSON for next agent
Error handling at each step with fallback strategies

base_url.description: The FleetOps API base URL should be provided by the user through environment variables or agent credentials. Never hardcode production URLs in tools or agents.

configuration_methods.method: User prompt: Ask user for their API endpoint

endpoint.description: Get truck information including route and telemetry

authentication.note: Future versions may require API keys

EMERGENCY_REROUTE CRITICAL
EMERGENCY_REROUTE HIGH

<threshold risk_score="<20"> CONTINUE LOW

best_practices.practice: Always prioritize cargo preservation over cost savings
Include safety buffers in time calculations (minimum 30 minutes)
Consider weather risks when selecting routes
Verify facility capabilities match cargo requirements
Provide post-recovery plans for rerouted shipments
